# synology_quickconnect_upnp (Resource)

QuickConnect automatic router port-forwarding policy. Enabling this can create router mappings. It never implicitly enables UPnP while configuring another QuickConnect setting. Destroy leaves DSM policy unchanged.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "synology_quickconnect_upnp" "nas" {
  enabled = false
}
import {
  to = synology_quickconnect_upnp.nas
  id = "quickconnect_upnp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Allow QuickConnect to configure automatic router port forwarding.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity and import identifier: quickconnect_upnp. Destroy only releases Terraform management; it never resets DSM settings.
